intent: Minimal premium dot-matrix display that adds character: cycles scenes with a per-dot dissolve.

layout.matrix: 72x16 default; pitch = width/cols; dpr capped at 2
layout.caption: scene counter + label left, prev/pause/next right

typography.bitmapFont: 5x7, A–Z 0–9 : . - / % +, 1px glyph gap, 2x scale when rows >= 16

color.bloom: shadowBlur in dot colour, grows with brightness level

motion.dissolve: per-dot stable random threshold vs 700ms progress

responsive.all: matrix scales to container width; dot count stays constant so the art never reflows

accessibility: canvas role=img with aria-label naming the scene (and marquee text)
